text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I saw Oguri Cap and 
Inari One having lunch together.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wiping out an extra-large serving in no 
time flat... You've got quite the appetite 
as always.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Don't praise me so much... I was just 
thinking about having curry next."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Cut it out, that wasn't a compliment... 
Wait, you're still eating?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If you eat that much with a race coming 
up, your Trainer's gonna get mad at you...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer... Am I eating too much?
choice_data_list: Moderation is key when it comes to meals.

You can't have any strength on an empty 
stomach!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I really have been eating too 
much...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Balance is what's truly 
important!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right. I'll stop for today 
after one more plate.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! You can't put up a fight on an 
empty stomach, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll eat my fill and make sure to put on a 
great run in the next race...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I think I finally get why Oguri chose you 
as her Trainer...
